briefdescription.para: Unified Lua configuration and scripting engine for END.

detaileddescription.para: lua::Engine is the single owner of the persistent Lua state that drives all user-tunable settings (previously split across Config and WhelmedConfig) and all keybinding/action definitions (previously owned by Scripting::Engine).
It inherits jam::Context<Engine> for process-wide singleton access and jam::File::Watcher::Listener for hot-reload on config file changes.

simplesect.para: All public methods are called on the MESSAGE THREAD.
